response.overview: Inspired by the rise of Trillville, this gritty drama follows a desperate record executive who risks his career, relationship, and future to discover the next breakout rap act during Atlanta’s explosive hip-hop era.
response.tagline: A struggling record executive risks his career and relationship while searching for the next breakout rap act in Atlanta’s explosive early-2000s hip-hop scene. Inspired by the rise of legendary Southern rap trio Trillville.
response.title: Welcome to Crunkville
